ev_0005.summary: Reconciled the supervisor's verified labels with CV evidence. Ten labelled points (B, C, H, A, D, P, E, F, G, Q) and twelve segments are consistent with the detected lines. Collinearities check out: B-A-P (BA extended to apex P), C-D-P (CD extended to P), H on BC, F on BA, E on CD, Q on AE. AD is parallel to BC, and FG is parallel to BC (both horizontal). Right angle at Q between HQ and AE: the measured angle is about 88.4 degrees, which agrees with perpendicularity, but detect_right_angle_marker found no square mark, so the mark is only supported by visual reading and is kept as a candidate. Segment styles match the supervisor list: BC, BA, CD, AD, AE and the first segments are solid; PA, PD, FG, GH, FH, EH and HQ are dashed. CV detected FH as a dashed chain (seg_04), which matches the supervisor's FH. G is not on FH.
